Claim 1 (Currently amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure, wherein said open rib structure is reinforced by a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover are secured to said body panel by fasteners.
